job: Send a sign-in link, invitation, receipt or alert as an email that matches the product.
purpose: A function, not a stylesheet: renderEmail({ theme, brand, preheader, blocks, locale }) returns an HTML part and a plain-text part. Colours come from the theme record as opaque hex, layout is presentation tables 560px wide with inline styles, dark mode is one prefers-color-scheme block, and the button works in Outlook. Nothing loads except the logo.
useWhen: The product sends a transactional message: a sign-in link, a one-time code, an invitation, a receipt or an alert.
The email must carry the same palette as the app without a web font or a stylesheet.

avoidWhen.when: The message is a marketing campaign with images and layouts a designer owns.
avoidWhen.instead: Use the email service's own template editor.

avoidWhen.when: The news belongs inside the app, where the person is already looking.
The page is a screen in the browser, not a message.

states.name: no logo
states.how: omit brand.logoUrl; a square in the accent colour carries the first letter of brand.name

states.name: no fallback link
states.how: fallback: false on a button block
